in_marathi.name: Hiten
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiten हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiten is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hit', meaning 'sun' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Hiten is a name for the sun god Surya. The name symbolizes the power, energy, and light that the sun brings to the world.
